items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: George Brent in the movies. That was his middle name.

ctx.x: Would you say that when you first, when the Wolverines were formed, you were conscious of this band as being in the forefront of jazz musicians? No. That it was going to have such an impact that it later had? No.

George Brent in the movies. That was his middle name. Yeah, we did. But, uh, somebody was asking about, uh, oh, I forgot who was, uh, wanted to know about Vicks, whether he was a queer. Oh, I know. Hokey Carmichael wrote me along. Vicks was this jerk's book. Oh, did he? Yeah. And asking a bunch of questions. If somebody was going to write a book and they wanted to know whether Vicks ever queer and this, that, and the other thing. Vicks definitely was not a queer. Definitely not. I had a question I wanted to ask…
